summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload on install
details: @servicetitan/carto-tokens declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip, extracts it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it to run the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a single-line 727 KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` bundle with a rotating string-array decoder (`WV8StW` shift routine) and hex-mangled identifiers, so the executed bytes cannot be reviewed at install time. `setup.mjs` itself uses hex-mangled identifiers and per-function string-lookup tables to hide constants. Executing the payload under Bun rather than Node also bypasses Node-oriented instrumentation. The package presents itself as a design-tokens library (DTCG JSON → vanilla-extract/Swift/Gradle outputs), a purpose that does not require a second language runtime or an obfuscated 727 KB install-time script; package.json ships no repository field and the `@servicetitan` scope resembles the ServiceTitan Inc. vendor namespace.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
